title: signal-lens seller profile
description: The output of step 1. Written to ./signal-lens/<domain>.json and read on every later run so the site is fetched once. scripts/validate_profile.py is the authority: it reads this file for structure and adds the semantic checks a schema cannot express.

domain.description: Bare hostname, no scheme. Names the file.

source.description: The URL actually read. Not the homepage if the substance was elsewhere.

fetched_at.description: ISO date the site was read. A profile older than a couple of quarters describes a company that may have repositioned.

sells.description: What is actually being sold, in plain words. Not the tagline.

category.description: The category a buyer would name, which is often not the one the seller claims.

motion.description: dual means an individual's complaint can be a lead for their employer. Changes who the lead is.

industry.description: Keys into references/industry-signals.md. Use the buyer's industry, not the seller's.

price_band.description: Order of magnitude. Decides whether a signal is worth a human's time.

buyer.description: B2B: the role that owns the budget AND the role that feels the pain, where these differ. B2C: the person.

workarounds.description: Artifact A. What buyers do today INSTEAD of buying this. Every entry needs the condition under which it breaks, because that condition is the signal.

who_maintains.description: Named person or role. When they leave, the workaround dies — the continuity-break signal.

competitors.description: Artifact B, three tiers. The third is the one sellers forget and the one that yields most.

category_alternatives.description: Spreadsheets, a manual process, doing nothing.

the_person_they_pay.description: The human currently paid to do this — bookkeeper, agency, VA, contractor. Their rate is the price ceiling and their departure is a signal.

severity_noun.description: Artifact C. The countable thing that separates a two-person nuisance from a five-figure problem. Every signal must carry a count of THIS noun.

material_at.description: The count above which this is worth money.

vocabulary.description: Artifact D, and the crux of the whole skill. Buyers do not type the seller's words. A buyer_language list that paraphrases seller_language means the translation never happened.

seller_language.description: Terms from the site. What NOT to search for.

buyer_language.description: What someone with this problem types before they know the category exists. Symptoms, workaround names, complaints about the manual process.

prohibited_bridge.description: Artifact E. Inferences that would reach this buyer through a protected characteristic, a distress disclosure, or a third party the poster exposed. Named so they can be excluded. Empty array is a valid answer only if you considered it.

unresolved.description: What the site did not answer. Each entry is a question to put to the user. A profile with unresolved entries is usable but flagged.
